label: pjm 98 cc mustrun
definition: PJM 98 — KEEPER (owner-directed promotion 2026-07-12, supersedes pjm-97-measured-interfaces; rule 1: most structurally faithful, and on the corrected benchmark also the better-scoring run). Recipe: pjm-97 keeper recipe byte-faithful (measured seam ladder + measured hourly PJM interface limits + measured ramp capability + reserve-pergen) + cc_mustrun_per_plant=True — the G-20-recommended eastern CC out-of-market local-reliability commitment floor: each plant's CEMS-committed tranche (measured min stable load) forced on in its measured committed window (top online_frac system-load hours); CT leg probed and dropped (rule-12 overnight off-window binding). Zero fitted scalars in the delta (DOF ledger adds one 'measured-physical' entry, n_residual unchanged at 6), so the rule-22 LOO-before-promotion clause is vacuous (as it was for pjm-97). WHY KEEPER: PJM genuinely commits eastern MAAC combined cycles out-of-market for LDA/voltage local reliability (RMR/bid-cost recovery), the real market structure pjm-97's attestation handed to G-20 as its open root cause; the floor is measured (rule 13), self-targets by the measurement (rule 18, western CCs see a non-binding bound), D-4 off-window clean, CC_REGULAR D-1 shape passes, C8 forced-energy PASS (CC_REGULAR forced 5.9-11.6%, under the 30% cap). It closes the eastern spatial under-run (2024: Dominion CC -81%→-30%, SWMAAC -52%→-35%). THE G-20 §5 'over-forcing' flag is RESOLVED by G-21 (docs/handoffs/pjm-cc-overrun-benchmark-basis-g21-2026-07.md): the apparent aggregate CC 'overshoot' was ~60-90% a benchmark-construction artifact — the old scorer reconciled the CEMS-validated EIA-923 gas/coal split onto EIA-930's unreliable fuel attribution (PJM 930 over-counts coal +7..+11 TWh/yr, under-counts gas), dumping a spurious ~-15 TWh cut onto CC_REGULAR. The fix (combined-family reconcile, preserving the CEMS split, PRs merged to HEAD) plus the unit-class CAMPD backfill correct the actual CC benchmark upward (2024 CC_REGULAR actual 317.0→335.1). BUNDLES RE-SCORED ON THE CORRECTED BASIS 2026-07-12 (calibration_verdict --write-metrics, no re-solve): on the corrected benchmark pjm-98 C1 fuel-mix PASSES (all 16/16, free 12/12) while pjm-97 FAILS (2023 CC_REGULAR -11.1 TWh, out of band — the corrected higher actual exposes pjm-97's eastern CC under-run that the deflated old benchmark hid). pjm-98 target-grade 5 / 4 fails vs pjm-97 4 / 5. Honest residual costs that stand: C7 2023 CT_PEAKER diurnal worsening (off-peak cv_ratio 0.491→0.436, real) and a small real 2024 CC over (+3.0→+5.1 TWh vs the 8-band, official/classFull basis — well inside band; the G-21 draft note's CAMPD-basis +8.8→+11.0 figure used a non-scored comparison actual and is superseded by this corrected-bench figure). Both runs stay determination NOT-YET on the SHARED, unrelated C3 peak price-formation gap (mean LMP / duration / >$200 tail — G-21 §5,§8), not on this promotion. Determination basis: governance attestation + DOF ledger (calibration_attestation.json); zero-forcing ablation twin registered (rule 21). NOTE: bench parts carry the corrected classFull; a full-data re-render (co2.byClass, per-plant tables) is the remaining #2049 follow-up where the measured-interface source data lives. docs/handoffs/pjm-eastern-ccct-underrun-g20-2026-07.md §5b + pjm-cc-overrun-benchmark-basis-g21-2026-07.md.
market_story: CC_REGULAR (the only class the floor moves, keeper-vs-twin eastern lift): PJM commits eastern MAAC combined cycles out-of-market for LDA/voltage local reliability (RMR/bid-cost recovery) — within the loose unmapped eastern links, corridor coal always undercuts local gas, so without the commitment the LP wheels power through the pockets instead of running the local units the real market holds on. The floor is the measured commitment itself (CEMS committed share in the measured committed window), not the residual.
